traderTypes.title: What kind of trader are you?
traderTypes.subtitle: Pick one or more styles that match how you usually trade or invest.

timeframes.title: Which timeframes do you use?
timeframes.subtitle: You can select multiple. Finn uses this to mute irrelevant signals.

assetFocus.title: What do you focus on?
assetFocus.subtitle: Choose the markets or assets Finn should weigh most in your context.

goals.title: What is your goal?
goals.subtitle: Choose one or more goals. Finn uses this to align coaching and warnings with your intent.

experience.title: How much experience do you have?
experience.subtitle: Choose what fits you best right now. You can select multiple levels if you sit between them.

risk.title: What is your risk profile?
risk.subtitle: This helps Finn decide when to slow you down, warn you, or give you more room. Combine options if it changes by context.

behavior.title: Which coaching patterns should Finn watch for?
behavior.subtitle: Select the behaviors that most often trip you up. This helps Finn coach more directly without changing governance.

onboardingStep.title: Who are you as a trader?
onboardingStep.description: Finn uses this profile to tune explanations, warnings, and setup guidance to your style right away. That gives you less noise and more relevant advice.
onboardingStep.finnSaysBody: You first, then the market. With your profile, Finn can decide which signals, timeframes, and warnings actually matter to you.
onboardingStep.footer: Save your profile to make the rest of onboarding more personal. After that you unlock the market and setup steps with much less noise.
onboardingStep.validationError: Please complete all profile fields first so Finn can guide you properly.
onboardingStep.saveError: Saving your trader profile failed. Please try again.

profilePage.title: This is how Finn learns who you are as a trader
profilePage.description: Finn uses this profile to tailor explanations, warnings, setups, and coaching to your style. Update it whenever your horizon, risk, or focus changes.
profilePage.pageDescription: Manage your account details and the Finn trader profile that shapes coaching, warnings, explanations, and behavioral guidance.
profilePage.summaryDescription: Your trading style, goals, risk profile, timeframes, and coaching patterns live in the trading profile section below.
profilePage.summaryHelper: Use the profile editor below to update it.
profilePage.serviceTierBody: Professional access is enabled. All intelligence nodes are synchronized with your account.
profilePage.loadError: The trader profile could not be loaded.
profilePage.saveError: Saving your trader profile failed. Please try again.
profilePage.validationError: Please complete all trader profile fields first so Finn can guide you properly.
profilePage.helper: Update this profile whenever your style changes. That keeps Finn relevant and reduces signals that do not fit how you trade.

banner.completeBody: You can move on to the next step or go back to your onboarding overview.

profile.title: Step 1 of 6 — Your trading profile
profile.action: Start by sharing what kind of trader you are, which horizon you use, and what Finn should watch.
profile.help: Finn uses this to adapt setups, explanations, and risk warnings to your style.

market.title: Step 2 of 6 — Market context
market.action: Open the market page and let Finn establish the current market picture first.
market.help: Without market context, Finn stays too generic in the advice that follows.

macro.title: Step 3 of 6 — Macro picture
macro.action: Add macro context so Finn can weigh regime and risk more accurately.
macro.help: Think DXY, yields, or liquidity: Finn uses this for the bigger picture.

technical.title: Step 4 of 6 — Technical signals
technical.action: Check technical signals so Finn can judge entries and timing more accurately.
technical.help: This step gives Finn evidence for trend, momentum, and timing.

setup.title: Step 5 of 6 — Create a setup
setup.action: Create your first setup so Finn can connect your rules to real situations.
setup.help: This is where Finn becomes more specific: not just context, but your preferences too.

strategy.title: Step 6 of 6 — Choose a strategy
strategy.action: Create your first strategy so dashboard, reviews, and reports become truly useful.
strategy.help: After this step Finn can review and prioritize your decisions much better.

onboardingOverview.title: Start in six clear steps
onboardingOverview.description: You do not have to understand everything at once. Work through the steps calmly from top to bottom. Finn uses this route to build your market context, setup, and strategy so advice, reviews, and reports become truly useful afterward.
onboardingOverview.finnComplete: Your foundation is ready. Open your dashboard now, review your first report, and ask Finn for your next step.

profile.title: Your trading profile
profile.description: Start by telling Finn what kind of trader you are, which horizon you use, and what Finn should pay attention to.
profile.finnHelp: Finn uses this profile to tailor advice, warnings, and explanations to your style right away.
profile.unlocks: More personal coaching and more relevant signals

market.title: Market context
market.description: Review live market data and let Finn establish the market picture first.
market.finnHelp: Finn uses this to build your first context and priorities.
market.unlocks: First market briefing and live context

macro.title: Macro picture
macro.description: Add macro context so Finn can weigh regime and risk more accurately.
macro.finnHelp: Think DXY, yields, and liquidity: this gives Finn the bigger picture.
macro.unlocks: Better risk assessment and regime context

technical.title: Technical signals
technical.description: Check technical signals so Finn can explain entries and timing more clearly.
technical.finnHelp: This gives Finn structure for trend, momentum, and timing.
technical.unlocks: Stronger timing, trend, and momentum guidance

setup.title: Create a setup
setup.description: Save your first setup so Finn can attach your context to concrete rules.
setup.finnHelp: This is where Finn becomes more specific: not just context, but your preferences too.
setup.unlocks: More personal reviews and sharper next steps

strategy.title: Choose a strategy
strategy.description: Create your first strategy so dashboard, reports, and reviews become truly useful.
strategy.finnHelp: After this step Finn can review, block, and prioritize decisions much better.
strategy.unlocks: Full dashboard, report, and review flow

onboardingComplete.title: Onboarding complete
onboardingComplete.description: Your foundation is ready. Finn now has enough context to make your dashboard, reports, and reviews much more targeted. Start calmly: open your dashboard, then check your report, and ask Finn for your next step.
onboardingComplete.finnBody: Open your dashboard first for the full picture. Then use report to see what matters today and ask Finn which next step makes most sense.
onboardingComplete.footer: You can always come back later to market, setup, or strategy to sharpen your context.
